choices.why: A light beige fabric three-seater with slim, low wooden legs, it brings the calm, warm, uncluttered japandi feel, and its 234 cm width fits the long right wall well.
A large natural jute rug (160x230) that can sit under the front legs of the sofa and the coffee table, adding warm texture over the dark floor.
Round, low and in plain wood with clean lines, it is the most japandi option and matches the sofa's wooden legs.
The tall rice paper floor lamp is exactly the lantern-style paper lamp you asked for, and it gives soft light in the corner beside the sofa.
The ZZ plant has tall, sculptural foliage, it is the only option with real presence as a large plant for the corner by the balcony glass, and it is easy to care for.

answer.why: Beige linen, natural jute, plain wood and rice paper make a serene, neutral palette that warms up the dark floor and the white walls, with few, low pieces that keep the japandi minimalism. The ZZ plant adds the one touch of green beside the balcony light.
